title: 第11章出人意料第12章德本说
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
管家心惊胆战，可是看到了老爷的脸色，他还是在一边附和说道：“是，是，敢在钱家动这些歪路子，真是不知死活。”
钱大有钱老爷有些意兴阑珊，他坐在椅子上，转着佛珠。但是转动佛珠的时候，他的身上戾气，不消反长！
这发喜财的手段，是他钱大有用过的。
就是没有想到，有朝一日，还有人能将他给旁人用的手段，还在他身上！
缓缓闭上眼睛。
钱老爷回想着发喜财的诸多缘由。
所谓发喜财，就是用死人讹钱的手段。
发喜财的手段，多种多样，颇具地域性，有扛尸贩苦恼子的，有上门叫丧冲天的，有哭魂打跌的。
这次用在他后宅上的，像是上门叫丧冲天。
只是这上门叫丧冲天的，昨天晚上后宅多出来了一具尸体，那今天早上就该有人上门哭丧。
故而他埋伏了人马，左等等不到，右等等不着。
这一番变故，叫钱老爷也有些惊疑不定了。
难道他猜错了？
转动着佛珠，他觉得这不像是本地人用的手段，但凡是本地人，多少也听过他钱大有的名声，知道这一套对他没用。
他本人市虎出身。
三爷更是衙门里头的人。
这样来说的话——
手中佛珠一停，钱大有睁开眼睛，突兀说道：“再去查查，看看附近有没有甚么没见过的生面孔，特别看看挂单的和尚，落单的道人。”
旁边的管家立刻应了一声，去安排了。
钱老爷则是眯着眼睛，回想起来了昨晚的事情，半夜三更，后宅，过道，站着的女尸，老夫人晚上从佛堂回来的路。

怒火未遏，但他又想到了这要紧的地方。
“对于我家后宅的事情，你们倒是熟悉的很！”
手里盘着佛珠，想到此处，每走一步佛珠，钱老爷心里的肝火就更旺三分！
虽然昨天就处置了护院。
可这内鬼，还是要好好盘盘！
管家嘱咐完外头回来，站在老爷身边，也不敢说话。
就看着老爷在椅子上转动佛珠，过了半晌，钱老爷又开口说道：“对了，你再给我找个合适的先生，我要给我娘驱驱晦气，她有些被吓走了魂，需要找人召魂。”
管家：“哎。”
等到管家再度走出，钱老爷一人坐在了圈椅之上，也不知道从哪里出来了一袭凉风，吹在了他的身边，叫钱老爷的鼻尖突然嗅到了一缕奇怪的香味。
仔细抽了抽鼻子，他觉得这香味有些熟悉。
站了起来，他蹙着眉头左右看了起来，没有发现正堂上有这样古怪的香气的来源。
转了一圈，重新坐回了椅子之上，转动佛珠，钱老爷又念起来了佛经。
全当自己方才得了癔症。
直到过了没一会儿，再度嗅到了这种味道。
钱老爷背后的汗毛耸立起来。
这一回，可不像是癔症了！他像是用弹簧一样从椅子上弹了起来，蹭蹭蹭几步，就走到了屋子外头。
“老爷。”
见到了突然跑出来的老爷，门口站着的两个家丁护院有些迷茫，但还是凑了上去。
钱老爷眼神之中，凶光闪烁，直接指着他们的鼻子说道：“去，杀一只黑狗，一只公鸡，再找一碗朱砂，再把老爷我放在了书房里面的那把刀拿过来！”
“哎！”

虽然不知道发生了甚么，但是看到自家老爷面色不好，他们也不敢多问，只能鸡飞狗跳的去做事情了。
至于钱大有。
他站在正堂外头，用力的抽动鼻子，嗅探着里头的味道，头上开始出汗了。
事情有些不对了起来。
要是他没有记错的话。
content_en:
The housekeeper was frightened, but after seeing the master's face, he still agreed and said: "Yes, yes, you dare to do such crooked things in the Qian family, you really don't know how to live or die."
Mr. Qian Dayouqian was a little disinterested. He sat on a chair and turned his Buddhist beads. But when he turned the beads, the anger in his body grew even more!
This means of making a fortune is something that his money has put to great use.
He just didn't expect that one day, someone would be able to use him for others to use, and he still had the means on his body!
Close your eyes slowly.
Master Qian thought about the many reasons for making a fortune.
The so-called making fortune means using dead people to extort money.
There are many ways to make a fortune, and they are quite regional. Some are carrying corpses to sell distressed children, some are calling people in mourning, and some are crying and depressed.
This time it was used on his back house, as if it was a call to mourn the sky.
It's just that this person came to the door to mourn. There was an extra body in the back house last night, so someone should come to the door to mourn this morning.
Therefore, he ambushed the men and horses, waiting to the left and unable to wait to the right.
This turn of events made Mr. Qian a little surprised and confused.
Did he guess wrong?
Turning the prayer beads, he felt that this was not a method used by locals, but any locals had heard of his reputation for being rich and knew that this trick would not work for him.
He himself was born in Ichitora.
The third master is a member of the Yamen.
If you put it this way——
As soon as the beads in his hand stopped, Qian Dayou opened his eyes and said abruptly: "Go and check again to see if there are any unfamiliar faces nearby, especially the monks who are on orders and the Taoists who are alone."
The butler next to him immediately responded and went to make arrangements.
Mr. Qian squinted his eyes and recalled what happened last night, the middle of the night, the back house, the corridor, the female corpse standing, and the old lady's way back from the Buddhist hall at night.
He was still furious, but he thought of this important point again.
"You are quite familiar with the affairs of my back house!"
Holding the Buddhist beads in his hand, thinking of this, every time he took the beads, Master Qian's heart became even more angry!
Although the nursing home was disposed of yesterday.
But this mole still needs to take stock!
The housekeeper came back after giving instructions and stood beside the master, not daring to speak.
I just watched the old man turning the beads on the chair. After a while, Mr. Qian said again: "By the way, you can find me a suitable husband. I want to drive away bad luck for my mother. She has been scared away and needs to find someone to summon her soul."
Butler: "Hey."
When the housekeeper walked out again, Mr. Qian sat alone on an armchair. A cool breeze came out from nowhere and blew around him, causing Mr. Qian's nose to suddenly smell a strange fragrance.
Sniffing his nose carefully, he felt that the scent was somewhat familiar.
Standing up, he frowned and looked around, but did not find the source of such a strange aroma in the main hall.
After turning around, he sat back on the chair, turned the beads, and Master Qian started to recite Buddhist scriptures again.
I just thought I had hysteria.
It wasn't until a while later that I smelled the smell again.
The hair on Master Qian's back stood up.
This time, it doesn’t look like hysteria! He bounced up from the chair like a spring, took a few steps, and walked outside the house.
"Master."
Seeing the master who suddenly ran out, the two servants standing at the door were a little confused, but they still came forward.
Mr. Qian's eyes flashed fiercely, and he pointed directly at their noses and said: "Go, kill a black dog and a rooster, find another bowl of cinnabar, and then bring over the knife that I put in the study!"
"Hey!"
Although they didn't know what happened, they didn't dare to ask more questions when they saw that their master looked bad, so they could only go about their business in a hurry.
As for having a lot of money.
He stood outside the main hall, twitching his nose vigorously, sniffingExploring the smell inside, my head began to sweat.
Something is wrong.
If he remembered correctly.
